summary.text: Marilyn Strickland is the Democratic incumbent for Washington's 10th Congressional District. Born in Seoul and raised in Tacoma, she served as mayor of Tacoma and as president and CEO of the Seattle Metropolitan Chamber of Commerce before her 2020 election to Congress. She serves on the House Armed Services and Transportation and Infrastructure committees and is running for re-election.

paragraphs.text: Strickland was born September 25, 1962, in Seoul, South Korea. Her family moved to Tacoma in 1967 after her father, a U.S. serviceman, was stationed at Fort Lewis, and she was raised in Tacoma and attended Mount Tahoma High School.
Her campaign website describes her as an "Army brat" and a graduate of Tacoma Public Schools.
She earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Washington and a master's degree in business administration from Clark Atlanta University.
Strickland worked in the private sector, including at Northern Life Insurance, before entering local government as a member of the Tacoma City Council.

She served two terms as mayor of Tacoma, from 2010 to 2018, according to her campaign website; Wikipedia describes her as the city's first Asian-born elected mayor and first African-American woman in the office.
After her mayoralty she became president and CEO of the Seattle Metropolitan Chamber of Commerce.

Strickland was elected to Congress in November 2020 and sworn in on January 3, 2021. Her campaign website calls her the first African-American and Korean-American woman elected to Congress, and her House website says she is the first African American to represent Washington state in federal office.

In the 119th Congress (2025-2026) she sits on the House Committee on Transportation and Infrastructure, with the Coast Guard and Maritime Transportation and Highways and Transit subcommittees, and on the Armed Services Committee, with the Military Personnel and Readiness subcommittees.
Her House website lists her as Whip of the New Democrat Coalition, Secretary of the Congressional Black Caucus, and chair of the New Democrat Coalition National Security Taskforce.

Outside government, Strickland has served as campaign chair of the United Way of Pierce County, as a trustee of the Tacoma Public Library and Annie Wright Schools, and as a board member of Grand Cinema.
According to her House website, she lives in the district with her husband.
